instruction: Ensure Chrome has exactly two tabs open: Apple and Amazon. Close the Google Scholar tab if present.

metadata.explanation: Task requires ensuring Chrome has exactly 2 tabs: Apple and Amazon, with Google Scholar tab closed. The evaluator checks the final tab state matches this requirement. Uses existing functions is_expected_tabs and get_open_tabs_info. Simplified from process-dependent to outcome-based verification since the evaluator only verifies final tab state, not the method used to achieve it.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Instruction requires exactly 2 tabs (Apple and Amazon) with Scholar tab closed. Evaluator verifies final tab state matches exactly using is_expected_tabs which checks both URL content and count.

Correct getter logic: get_open_tabs_info (chrome.py:623) correctly extracts all open tab URLs from Chrome via Playwright CDP, iterating through all browser contexts and pages to build list of {title, url} dicts.

Correct metric logic: is_expected_tabs (chrome.py:120) properly verifies both URL matching and tab count. Uses are_lists_equal with compare_urls to check expected_urls match actual_urls exactly, returns 1.0 only if both match.
Correct expected values: Expected URLs ['https://www.apple.com/', 'https://www.amazon.com/'] semantically match instruction requirements for Apple and Amazon tabs.

Outcome-based verification appropriate: Instruction states 'Ensure Chrome has exactly two tabs open' which is an outcome requirement. Evaluator correctly verifies final state without requiring specific process.
Initial state properly configured: Config opens Apple and Scholar tabs (lines 28-33), requiring agent to add Amazon tab and remove Scholar tab to achieve required state.
No postconfig needed: Chrome tab state is persistent and accessible via CDP at evaluation time without reopening UI.
Rule validator warning is false positive: Heuristic warning about UI/state-dependent tasks does not apply - Chrome tab state remains accessible via CDP without UI reopening.
